stem.en: A flywheel spins rapidly about a fixed axle while its centre stays put. What is its kinetic energy?
stem.et: Hooratas pöörleb kiiresti ümber kinnitatud telje, samal ajal kui selle kese püsib paigal. Kui suur on selle kineetiline energia?

label.en: ½Iω², stored entirely in the rotation
label.et: ½Iω², mis on tervikuna talletatud pöörlemises

label.en: Zero, since the wheel as a whole is not travelling anywhere
label.et: Null, sest ratas tervikuna kuhugi ei liigu

label.en: ½mv² using the speed of the axle, which is zero
label.et: ½mv², kasutades telje kiirust, mis on null

label.en: Proportional to ω rather than ω², since energy grows in step with spin rate
label.et: Võrdeline ω-ga, mitte ω²-ga, sest energia kasvab koos pöörlemiskiirusega
